Messages.Author: Dog
Messages.Body:
Hi LSJ, just a quick question...

We notice that taste of vitae is "only playable after strike resolution".

So can I play it after additional strikes have been declared but before they
are resolved?

Can I play it after my opponent has pressed but before the beginning of the
new round?

Or is the word "immediately" somehow assumed to apply to the "after strike
resolution"? :o)

Thanks

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Dog" <warp...@biosys.net> wrote:
> Hi LSJ, just a quick question...
>
> We notice that taste of vitae is "only playable after strike resolution".
>
> So can I play it after additional strikes have been declared but before they
> are resolved?

After you play Blur or other additional strike-gaining effects (which are also
played "after strike resolution"), but not between the time additional strikes
are choosen ("hands for 1" or "Burning Wrath") and the time they resolve.

> Can I play it after my opponent has pressed but before the beginning of the
> new round?

It would be played before presses.

> Or is the word "immediately" somehow assumed to apply to the "after strike
> resolution"? :o)

The word "immediatly" is implied in many of these "after" situations.
(Akram, Anneke, Cardinal Sin: Insubordination, Cryptic Rider, etc.)
